title: Sensing and Responding
seo_title: Grade 4 Science: Sensing and Responding Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: All living things sense and respond to their environment: the five human senses, special senses of other animals (echolocation, magnetoreception), and plant responses to light, touch, water and gravity. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science 4, Biology)
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 science worksheets (BC): the five senses, the brain and nerves, how animals sense their world, and how plants respond to light and gravity. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Living things sense changes and respond to them.
key_sub: Senses send signals to the brain; the brain decides.
body_html:
How to think about it

Humans have five senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch. Sense organs send signals along nerves to the brain, which decides how to respond. Some animals have special senses: bats use echolocation, birds can sense Earth's magnetic field, and some snakes sense heat (infrared).

Plants respond too: shoots grow toward light, roots grow down with gravity, and some leaves fold when touched.

Example

A bat flies in the dark without hitting trees. Which sense helps it?

It listens to echoes.

Answer: echolocation (hearing)

Example

A plant on a windowsill bends toward the window. Why?

Plants need light.

Answer: it grows toward the light

Common mistakes

  • Thinking plants cannot respond to anything.
  • Thinking the eyes 'see' without the brain.
  • Mixing up stimulus (the change) and response (the reaction).

items.q: Which of these is a structural adaptation?
c: a dog that pants on a hot day
a stick insect with a body that looks like a twig
a millipede that curls up when it is touched
an owl that hunts at night
items.e: Structural adaptations are body parts. Behavioural adaptations are things an organism does.

items.q: What is a structural adaptation?

items.e: Webbed feet and gills are structural adaptations.

items.q: What is a behavioural adaptation?

a structural adaptation to stay safe, because predators find it hard to pick out one fish
items.e: Something the animal does is a behaviour, so it is a behavioural adaptation.
